answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it explicitly reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm, both central to sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Memory 44 strongly supports qualified pipeline creation, though it omits closed-won revenue, retention, and sales-efficiency outcomes. Memories 31 and 86 show durable/early adoption improvements that are plausible leading indicators but do not establish qualified revenue or long-term retention. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift for price-sensitive SMBs, but omits margin, retention, qualification quality, and whether promotional pricing is sustainable. Memory 91 reports week-one engagement and first meaningful action only, without demonstrated activation durability, monetization, qualification, or retention effects.
